analyst_view.overall: Fifth-placed Real Sociedad (22 pts) host sixth-placed Sevilla (19 pts) on Sunday night in a game between European-place rivals; the numbers lean to a home win with about 3.1 goals. Pellegrino Matarazzo's side lost 3-2 at Racing on Sunday and play Crystal Palace away in the Europa League on Thursday, so they get three days' rest after a trip to London, which the numbers don't count. The numbers also carry no team news for this game: Real Sociedad are without Yangel Herrera, Barrenetxea, Odriozola, Astiazaran and Sucic (illness), with Aramburu and Sarr doubtful; Sevilla, who drew the derby 1-1 with Betis, miss Carmona, Alfon Gonzalez, Miguel Sierra and Marcao, and have a Copa del Rey game three days later, so some rotation is possible. No referee is named yet.

goals.text: The numbers say 3.1 goals, 1.8 for Real Sociedad, and they know nothing of either side's absences. Real Sociedad lose two creative players in Sucic and Barrenetxea and come off a Thursday trip to Crystal Palace, and Sevilla lose winger Alfon Gonzalez and may rotate before the cup, so I lean a little lower, about 2.9. Both defences are also short (Odriozola, Carmona, Marcao), which keeps the lean small.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.5 corners, 5.4 for Real Sociedad, already a touch lower for their recent corners. Losing Barrenetxea takes width away from the home side, but tired legs after Europe often mean more defending and clearing, and Sevilla have conceded few corners lately (already counted). Nothing clear either way, so I stay at about 9.5.

cards.text: The numbers say 5.3 cards, 3.1 for Sevilla, already raised for Sevilla's 20 bookings in their last six (+3.8%). It is a game between near rivals for the European places, but not a derby, and no referee is named yet. I find nothing the numbers can't see, so I stay at 5.3.

shots.text: The numbers say 24.7 shots, already raised for both sides' busy recent shooting (+10.2% for Real Sociedad, +5.0% for Sevilla). Real Sociedad play in London three days earlier without Sucic, Barrenetxea and Herrera, and Sevilla may rotate before their cup game, so I lean a little lower, about 23.7.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 8.3 shots on target, close to both sides' recent accuracy. The same absences and the Europa League trip that take shots off should take a few on target off too, so I lean slightly lower, about 8.0; Oyarzabal and Oskarsson up front keep it a small move.
